title: Hearty Aerated Syrian Rice Tagine
description: A comforting Syrian dish featuring a soffritto base, vanilla pod, and a touch of wine.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Short-grain rice (e.g. Calrose or Japanese mochigome) recommended.

ingredients.name: White wine
ingredients.notes: Dry white wine, such as Sauvignon Blanc.

ingredients.name: Vanilla pod
ingredients.notes: Scrape seeds, use pod as well.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use to taste; adjust for low-sodium broth.

instructions: Combine ghee, onion, and garlic in donabe or Dutch oven over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon or spatula, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add rice, chicken broth, wine, vanilla pod, allspice, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until liquid is mostly absorbed and rice is tender, about 25-30 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, then remove vanilla pod and discard.
Check seasoning and adjust as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Let tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving for best flavor and texture.
Transfer leftovers to an airtight container and refrigerate or freeze for later use.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
